gui.maid_legion.help.title: Maid Legion - How to use
gui.maid_legion.help.p1.title: What this is
gui.maid_legion.help.p1.1: Maid Legion gathers the maids of Touhou Little Maid into one screen: batch summon, batch recall, revival after death, and experience upgrades.
gui.maid_legion.help.p1.2: Press '.' to open the terminal (rebindable in Controls). The batch summon/recall hotkey is unbound by default; bind it yourself.
gui.maid_legion.help.p1.3: The hotkey only ever affects maids you have ticked, so it cannot touch ones you left alone.
gui.maid_legion.help.p2.title: Recruiting maids
gui.maid_legion.help.p2.1: Hold a gohei and shift-right-click a maid to add her to the legion. Do it again to remove her.
gui.maid_legion.help.p2.2: Only maids in the legion appear in the terminal and answer to the hotkey and batch actions.
gui.maid_legion.help.p2.3: That is deliberate: a stray click can never drag in a maid you never meant to manage.
gui.maid_legion.help.p2.4: Duplicate names are fine. The #xxxx suffix on each row identifies her.
gui.maid_legion.help.p3.title: The four states
gui.maid_legion.help.p3.1: Present: she is beside you in this dimension and can be recalled directly.
gui.maid_legion.help.p3.2: Stored: she is kept as data, holding no chunk and costing nothing. Summon releases her any time.
gui.maid_legion.help.p3.3: Unloaded: she is still in the world but her chunk is not loaded. Turn on force-load for her before she can be summoned.
gui.maid_legion.help.p3.4: Fallen: she died. This mod takes custody - no tombstone, no dropped items - and keeps her items and experience on her. Click her status badge to revive her.
gui.maid_legion.help.p3.5: A revive costs 1x lapis, gold, redstone, iron and coal, matching TLM's altar recipe rather than undercutting it.
gui.maid_legion.help.p4.title: The price of force-loading
gui.maid_legion.help.p4.1: With force-load on, that maid's chunk stays loaded, which is why she can be summoned from far away or another dimension.
gui.maid_legion.help.p4.2: The cost is that the chunk keeps using server resources, more so the more maids you enable.
gui.maid_legion.help.p4.3: It is set per maid and saved with the world.
gui.maid_legion.help.p5.title: Upgrades (paid with her experience)
gui.maid_legion.help.p5.1: Tick exactly one maid in the terminal and press Upgrades. There are 9 upgrades, each up to level 100, paid from that maid's own experience.
gui.maid_legion.help.p5.2: She earns experience from the orbs she picks up and from P-points she picks up (each worth 1/4 experience).
gui.maid_legion.help.p5.3: Each tier costs more: levels 1-20 cost 20 each, 21-40 cost 120, 41-60 cost 600, 61-80 cost 2500, 81-100 cost 6000.
gui.maid_legion.help.p5.4: Maxing one upgrade takes roughly 185,000 experience. Levels live in the save, so restarts, storing and reviving never lose them.
gui.maid_legion.help.p6.title: Legion abilities (paid with P-points)
gui.maid_legion.help.p6.1: Legion abilities are paid from the bank, not TLM's wallet. TLM hard-codes its wallet cap at 5.0, so this mod adds a bank with a much higher ceiling.
gui.maid_legion.help.p6.2: Auto-deposit is on by default: whenever the wallet passes 1.0, the excess moves into the bank every second. That keeps pickup room free, so points bank instead of overflowing into vanilla experience.
gui.maid_legion.help.p6.3: Abilities are one-off purchases and apply permanently to every enrolled maid, including stored and fallen ones, as soon as they load.
